checks.describe: importing the same submodule twice returns the exact same cached module object -- import runs the file once (section 1)
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/platformops python3 -c "import sys; import platformops.inventory.data as d1; import platformops.inventory.data as d2; print(d1 is d2); print('platformops.inventory.data' in sys.modules)"

checks.describe: a re-exported function still reports rules.py as its __module__ and source file -- __init__.py re-exports a reference, it does not move the code (section 3)
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/platformops python3 -c "import inspect; from platformops.inventory import find_missing_owner; print(find_missing_owner.__module__); print(inspect.getsourcefile(find_missing_owner).endswith('rules.py'))"

checks.describe: python file.py on a file that uses relative imports fails -- only python -m platformops.inventory gives the package context those imports need (section 2)

assert.contains: attempted relative import with no known parent package
